digest.component_or_area: rebar.llm public API / external integration tests
propositions: The public API rebar.llm.review_ticket() was removed in a pre-1.0 breaking change but two external test modules still call it, causing AttributeError in 4 CI lanes of the Live External Integration workflow.

External test modules (test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and test_llm_trace.py) were excluded from the standard Verified gate verification step, so the removal epic's automated retargeting missed these call sites.

The replacement review_plan() API has an incompatible result contract (PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT with no top-level findings field) compared to what the tests assert (REVIEW_RESULT with runner/model/findings), so review_code() is the correct retarget.
Both external modules must be retargeted to rebar.llm.review_code (surviving public op returning REVIEW_RESULT) to satisfy their existing assertions for runner, model, and findings.
